goals.title: Student Achievement and Post-Secondary Success
goals.desc: Conroe ISD's goals for student academic performance, graduation rates, and post-secondary readiness — measured against state STAAR exams and TEA data.

goals.title: School Leadership and Fiscal Responsibility
goals.desc: Goals for district leadership quality and responsible management of resources.

goals.title: Recruitment, Development, and Retention of Staff
goals.desc: Goals for recruiting, developing, and retaining highly-qualified staff.

goals.title: Safe and Collaborative School Culture
goals.desc: Goals for school safety, culture, and family engagement.

goals.title: Effective Instruction
goals.desc: Goals for delivering effective, objective-driven instruction.

objectives.text: Performance Objective 1: Increase the percent of third grade students that score Meets grade level or above on STAAR Reading from 52% to 56% by 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase the percent of third grade students that score Meets grade level or above on STAAR Reading from 52% to 56%

objectives.text: Performance Objective 2: Increase the student performance level on TEKS 8.5E (making connections) from 50% to 55% by May 2025 as measured on the eighth grade ELAR STAAR.
objectives.short_label: Increase the student performance level on TEKS 8.5E (making connections) from 50% to 55%

objectives.text: Performance Objective 3: Increase the student performance level on TEKS E1.9 C (revising) from 64% to 69% by May 2025 as measured on the English I EOC.
objectives.short_label: Increase the student performance level on TEKS E1.9 C (revising) from 64% to 69%

objectives.text: Performance Objective 4: Increase the performance of students served through ESL and/or SPED, to at least 60% at the Approaches grade level on the STAAR English I and English II EOC by May 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase the performance of students served through ESL and/or SPED, to at least 60% at the Approaches grade level on the STAAR English I and English II EOC
objectives.metric_label: English I EOC Reading/ELA (Approaches) — Special Education

objectives.text: Performance Objective 5: Increase the performance of students receiving Dyslexia services by 5% at the Meets grade level from the previous year as measured on the STAAR Reading assessment by May 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase the performance of students receiving Dyslexia services by 5% at the Meets grade level from the previous year

objectives.text: Performance Objective 6: Increase the percentage of third grade students from 51% to 55% at the Meets grade level as measured on the STAAR Math assessment by May 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase the percentage of third grade students from 51% to 55% at the Meets grade level

objectives.text: Performance Objective 7: Increase the performance in third through sixth grade on TEKS that include representing and solving multi-step word problems involving the four operations (add, subtract, multiply, and divide) as measured by the 2025 Math STAAR assessment.
objectives.short_label: Increase the performance in third through sixth grade on TEKS that include representing and solving multi-step word problems involving the four operations

objectives.text: Performance Objective 8: Increase the performance in seventh and eighth grades on TEKS that include applying rational number operations to concepts pertaining to area and surface area as measured by the 2025 Math STAAR assessment.
objectives.short_label: Increase the performance in seventh and eighth grades on TEKS that include applying rational number operations to concepts pertaining to area and surface area

objectives.text: Performance Objective 9: Increase performance in seventh grade, eighth grade, and Algebra 1 on TEKS applying rational number operations to concepts of linear relationships (tables, graphs, slope, etc.) as measured by the 2025 Math/EOC STAAR assessment.
objectives.short_label: Increase performance in seventh grade, eighth grade, and Algebra 1 on TEKS applying rational number operations to concepts of linear relationships

objectives.text: Performance Objective 10: Increase students served in Special Education to 58% at the Approaches grade level as measures by the Algebra I STAAR EOC assessment.
objectives.short_label: Increase students served in Special Education to 58% at the Approaches grade level
objectives.metric_label: Algebra I EOC Math (Approaches) — Special Education

objectives.text: Performance Objective 11: Increase performance of Emergent Bilingual students from 45% to 48% at the Meets level as measured on the eighth grade US History STAAR by May 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase performance of Emergent Bilingual students from 45% to 48% at the Meets level

objectives.text: Performance Objective 12: Increase performance level on TEKS 11.28 (related to differentiating sources and information) from 80% to 82% on the US History EOC by May 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase performance level on TEKS 11.28 from 80% to 82% on the US History EOC

objectives.text: Performance Objective 13: Increase performance of students served through ESL and/or Special Education, to at least 48% at the Approaches grade level on the eighth grade Social Studies STAAR assessment by May 2025.
objectives.short_label: Increase performance of students served through ESL and/or Special Education, to at least 48% at the Approaches grade level on the eighth grade Social Studies STAAR assessment

objectives.text: Performance Objective 14: Increase student performance in fifth grade, eighth grade, and Biology EOC by 3% at the Masters grade level as measured by the 2025 Science/EOC STAAR assessment.
objectives.short_label: Increase student performance in fifth grade, eighth grade, and Biology EOC by 3% at the Masters grade level

objectives.text: Performance Objective 15: Increase the student performance of Economically Disadvantaged students, Emergent Bilinguals, and Special Education students achieving Meets grade level passing standard by 3% in fifth grade, eighth-grade, and Biology EOC as measured by the 2025 Science/EOC STAAR Assessment.
objectives.short_label: Increase the student performance of Economically Disadvantaged students, Emergent Bilinguals, and Special Education students achieving Meets grade level passing standard by 3% in fifth grade, eighth-grade, and Biology EOC

objectives.text: Performance Objective 16: Increase the percentage of high school graduates that are College, Career, or Military Ready (CCMR) from 63% to 76% by 2025. High Priority
objectives.short_label: Increase the percentage of high school graduates that are College, Career, or Military Ready (CCMR) from 63% to 76%

objectives.text: Performance Objective 17: Maintain a dropout rate of 2% or less for all students and student groups in seventh through twelfth grade.
objectives.short_label: Maintain a dropout rate of 2% or less for all students and student groups in seventh through twelfth grade

objectives.text: Performance Objective 18: Maintain a High School graduation rate of 97.1% or higher.

objectives.text: Performance Objective 13: High School - dropout prevention measures increases CISD graduation rate. The best of the 4-year, 5-year or 6-year state graduation rates is used for Domain I: All students, seven race/ethnic groups, SpEd, and EB. The best of these graduation rates for the 2020 graduates was the 5-year rate at 97.3%. Goal for 2021 graduates: The best of the 3 rates will increase from 97.4% to 97.5%. HB 3 Texas Consolidated State Plan and ESEA Section 1111(c)(4)(A): Graduation Rate, and Dropout reduction [TEC 11.252(a)(3)9C)]
